name: ZOUR x BITEZ Micros 3,000MG Gummies - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Cherry Lime
description: Cherry Lime delivers a bold balance of sweet and tart flavor. Juicy cherry pairs with bright, zesty lime for a fruit-forward combination that starts sweet and finishes with a refreshing citrus tang. This Ocho Extracts x Zour Stash collab packs a 500mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend per gummy—half the potency of the original BITEZ for a smoother, more manageable experience (6 gummies per bag, 3,000mg total). A vibrant blend of sweet cherry and tangy lime in every bite.
